aspect: The reason is genuine and secondary
description: A light, a lane change, a registration check. The ground is sound, and the selection of who to apply it to is not reviewable.
Being polite, still and cooperative does not reliably end the encounter sooner, which is what the people most stopped already know.
energy_note: Doing everything right changes nothing about the length.

aspect: VILLAIN SCENE - the check that keeps going
description: Licence, insurance, then the boot, then whether anyone else has driven the car recently, then whose name the finance is in. Twenty-five minutes. No ticket is issued. 'Drive safe now.'
energy_note: Twenty-five minutes and no ticket, which is the point.

aspect: Objecting is the offence that was available all along
description: Obstruction and public order provisions are broad enough that the reaction to a stop can supply the charge the stop did not.
energy_note: Nothing to charge, until she objects.
